Q1: Glyoxylic acid presents known hazards (Tier 1) for dermal and eye exposure, with an expanded perspective (Tier 2) suggesting potential for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive, and environmental hazards. Data are deficient (Tier 4) regarding its endocrine disruption, inhalation, and organ/systemic hazards, though oral hazards are assessed as low to moderate (Tier 3).
